paite: Paul, Silvanas leh Timothi in, Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist a Thessalonika a om saptuamte kiang ah;
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
Unaute aw, na ginna uh nakpitak a khanglian in, na vek ua na ki-ittuah chiatna uh akhan semsem ziak in noumau tungthu ah Pathian kiang a kipahthu gengen ding him ka hi uh; huai ka hihtuak him uh ahi.
heading: Kipahthu Genna

paite: Huaiziak in mi'n ahon sawina tengteng uleh gim na thuaknate ua na kuhkaldan uleh na ginna ziak un Pathian saptuam pawlte lak ah koute mahmah in ka hon suang uhi.
Huai lah Pathian' vaihawmna adiktat chih chiamtehna ahi a, tu a Pathian kumpigam mi a seh tak na hi uh chih kilatna semsem ahi; huaiziak a leng thuak na hi ngal ua.
heading: Pathian In Thuk Nawn Ding

paite: Pathian in nou hon hihgimte gimthuakna a thuk diktathuai in asepta hi.
Toupa Jesu van a kipan a-angel hatte toh meikuang a hong kilak chiang a, nou hihgim a omte koute toh khawlna ahon pe ding hi.
Pathian theiloumi leh i Toupa Jesu tanchinhoih taksangloute tung ah phu ala ding hi.
Amau tangtawn manthatna a gawtna leh Toupa omna leh athilhihtheihna thupina a kipan posiahna athuak ding ua,

amah ahong pai chiang in misiangthoute hih thupi in a-om ding ua, gingtute tengteng lak ah lamdangsak in a-om ding uhi, ka hon thu theihsak uh na gintak ziak un nou leng amaute lak ah na tel sam ding uhi.

Huchi a hih thupi leh lamdangsak ahihtheihna ding a i Pathian in nou ahon sapna a sap tuak him ahon saktheihna ding in leh lungtaina chiteng leh ginna nasep chiteng a thilhihtheihna a ahon lohchinsak theihna ding in noute a ding in ka hon thumsak gige uhi;
huchi a i Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna bang zel a i Toupa Jesu min noumau a hih thupi a om a, noumau leng amah a hih thupi a na omtheihna ding un.
